unresolved.why: NE combines a merged North-West (Ngamiland + Chobe) with separate city/town atoms — a layout that never existed (Chobe merge c.2001 and split c.2006 are themselves unsure). The NE Gaborone atom (286 km² vs 169 km² official) contains Mogoditshane (Kweneng) and Tlokweng (South-East), so the Kweneng, South-East and probably Kgatleng outlines are not legal ones. The ~1980 changes (Tuli, Lobatse, Chobe) are undated.
